item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Verify Firebase authentication token. Returns JWT tokens if user exists, or isNewUser flag if new user.

**Supports both:**
- Mobile: Phone OTP authentication
- Web: Email/Password authentication

Register a new user. Requires authentication with temporary token from /verify endpoint.

**Required fields:**
- fullName: User's full name
- gender: 'Male' or 'Female'
- age: Integer between 0-150

**Note:** Use the temporary token received from /verify endpoint (when isNewUser is true).

Refresh the access token using a refresh token.

**Token Rotation:** This endpoint implements token rotation for enhanced security:
- Returns a NEW refresh token (the old one is revoked)
- Returns a new access token
- Automatically cleans up expired tokens from the database

**Important:** Always use the NEW refreshToken from the response for subsequent refresh calls. The old refresh token becomes invalid after this call.
Logout user and revoke refresh token. Requires authentication.
Get current authenticated user's profile. Requires authentication.

item.description: Authentication endpoints for user login, registration, and token management.

request.description:
Create a new community. **Admin only**. Requires authentication with admin role.

**Types:** Club, Shop, Women, Youth, Family, Corporate
**Locations:** Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Al Ain, Sharjah
**Category:** Array of strings (e.g., ["City Communities"], ["Group Communities"], ["Awareness & special communities"])
**Image:** Base64 string (e.g., "data:image/jpeg;base64,...") or URL
**isPublic:** Boolean (default: false) - Set to true to make community publicly visible
**isFeatured:** Boolean (default: false) - Set to true to feature the community
Update an existing community. **Admin only**. All fields are optional. Requires authentication with admin role.
Delete a community. **Admin only**. Requires authentication with admin role.
Get a specific community by ID. Public endpoint.
Get members of a specific community. Public endpoint.
Join a community. Requires authentication. Users can join multiple communities.
Leave a community. Requires authentication.
